text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —It's not a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything that is about to happen is not a dream.
So, let's keep our eyes wide open.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make intense, unforgettable memories for me... and for everyone!
Let's make every single moment—shine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then,
I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her words trailed off there.
But—that was enough.
That was more than enough to convey her feelings."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day it was decided she would run in the Twinkle Series.
With sparkling eyes, she was bursting with excitement
for the future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she heads toward the greatest conclusion right now—
Fine Motion is more beautiful
than in any of my memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm off...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can finally race against Fine-san at her full strength.
I've been looking forward to this so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-chan...
I'm sorry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because you love being number one, right, Scarlet-chan? But...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because number one today is definitely going to be me♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ahaha, that really felt like your all-out best!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me, I don't plan on giving an inch either!
—Sorry in advance if I can't send you off with a win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, I gotta get back to prepping.
I'll be going now!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I was wishing for it all along.
For this day to come... to run alongside you in an actual race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Because for my final opponent, I wanted it to be you—the one who started this journey with me."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't feel a single millimeter
of sentiment toward you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, you made up your mind.
...Everything will converge just as planned."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You couldn't do it.
So... I will."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —I'll smash it all to pieces. The language of God, your convictions—I'll crush them all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it,
what kind of face is that supposed to be?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't say that
just to hype you up, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How could my heart not race!?
I mean, right now you're so incredibly noble...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, hit me with everything you've got!
Give me all your passion!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, so those are your true colors, huh? 
I like you better this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Smirking like you've got it all figured out.
...You've always pissed me off.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's funny.
Because that just sounds like a love letter to me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you out of your mind?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe so!
Looks like I've gone crazy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Let's hurry and run!
